title: Sylvester Thompson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Sylvester Thompson." Historical Document Record (2006). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Sylvester Elwood Thompson of Millsboro, Delaware was born on June 13, 1945 to Bertha Thompson and the late George Thompson. He departed this life on September 15, 2006, at Beebe Hospital, Lewes, Delaware, at the age of 61. He worked for Allen Baker prior to becoming ill in 1995. He was educated in the Millsboro school system and also attended the William C. Jason school of Georgetown. He was preceded in death by his father George and a brother, Basil Ronnie Thompson. He leaves his mother Bertha; three daughters, Sylvia, Barbara and Laura Norman, all of Seaford, Delaware; two brothers, George and Bruce Thompson of Millsboro; one sister, Mildred Harman of Lewes; nine grandchildren and two great-grandchildren; and a host of nieces, nephews, family and friends.
